acceptance_sequence: materialize deterministic system from campaign context
persist system and stable entity IDs before any sensor request
issue or load an operational scan order
build sensor scan request from console/operator/system state
resolve request against pre-existing detectable signatures
update observer knowledge without mutating target truth
append operational events for order, action, result and report
optionally hand off authorized structured result to another console
save/reload and verify persistent world/entity identity
repeat identical unresolved scan context and verify deterministic result

must_pass.expected: Same seed, era/date, sector/context and generator version reproduce the same unresolved structured world.
Every detected entity/signature exists in authoritative World State before the scan.
Materialized entity IDs survive reload and are never regenerated because the player rescans.
Scan resolution changes observation/knowledge only; it does not add target properties or entities.
Hidden properties are omitted until resolution/filter requirements are satisfied.
Player-facing results never expose authoritative entity_id, full ground truth or unresolved hidden properties.
Detections use observer-relative stable contact identifiers appropriate to available knowledge.
Sensor capability, power, integrity, scan mode, resolution, duration, interference and masking affect result.
Order → acknowledgement → action start → result → report/data handoff is causally linked in the append-only event log.
Event recording does not create universal NPC knowledge; visibility/projection rules govern who learns what.
AI/UI may verbalize structured sensor results but cannot add discoveries, identities or causes.
Reload preserves world entities, identity lineage, relevant observer knowledge and operational history.
Fixture date and available technology are valid for the selected playable era.

runtime_note: This fixture defines Star Trek-side acceptance. Executable runtime realization belongs in CoreRPG/UE5 and must not be duplicated inside this repository.
